comments.content: Boone is out for himself. So is Jack. Dirtbags lining their pockets with Corte cash. Rumor is they  are under federal investigation. One can hope.
Mayor Wilson did good to veto the council decision to allow the thousands of new cars in the form of apartment dwellers.

I hope they are under a Federal investigation!!  This also shows what kind of City Council President we have to continue to allow Boone to vote without bringing up his conflicts.   Why has the other council members not spoken up about this as well?  Does this show how "knowledgeable" they are about law & finance??    I think not.
Kant is definitely running again. I wonder what Burrell thinks about that? LOL.
How funny to say " Kant is definitely running again"  -  When all comes out about Kant & what he did in office - He will be in an Orange or striped suit behind bars!!!  Just wait!!

Oh come on,  what's wrong with a little wink, a nod, and some "form" of appreciation?
If you all are waiting for the Ethics (cough) Commission to step in, you will be waiting a looooong time

ITS IN THE PIPELINE 
They are going down

I appreciate this blog. The newspapers don't cover politics like they used to. I know this blog has gotten folks' attention. I have a friend at the county and he said everybody reads it and talks about it in Bay Minette.

I have said often that the fingers of the Baldwin County good ole boys reach all the way to Montgomery.  The good ole boys include lawyers, Commissioners, and people in authority who are responsible for policing just what you wrote about .   Do we really think the Ethics Commission will do their job or are they tainted?

I hope I am wrong but the developers are going to get their apartments in.   There is too much money and political influence in this project.    Corte and his cash; Boone and Burrell with their interests; the lawyer for Corte and his connection to Catalyst; and the real estate industry with its influence has this project surrounded on all sides.   Please prove me wrong
Isn't that the way it has always been. Different names same old story. Until someone steps up for what's best for the community.
Fairhope needs to stop pumping raw sewage into the bay! Disgusting.

The sewage can only increase with the added houses unless they add on to the sewage plant.   If they add on we will all have to pay for it.  See how uncontrolled growth costs us all except the predatory developers?
